messages.text: It ships November 30, 2026, and it's $799 today. It mines Bitcoin and Dogecoin at the same time, so it would pair well with your Magic M. 40T. Would you run it alongside the 40T?
Read the bsb b30 dual page
Searched the catalog · Harlo H15 Dual Bitcoin Dogecoin

Good pairing. The H15 adds 15 TH/s of Bitcoin hashing alongside your 40T, plus 1.08 GH/s on Dogecoin and Litecoin, so you get draws on two chains at once.

It runs at about 500 W, which is roughly 360 kWh a month. What do you pay per kWh in (address hidden)? With that I can give you the monthly power cost and the sats it should stack.

At 12¢ a kWh in (address hidden), the H15 costs about $43 a month to run. It mines Bitcoin and Dogecoin at the same time, which the 40T can't do. With both running, you'll have about 55 TH/s on Bitcoin, and every ten minutes each machine gets another shot at a full 3.125 BTC block.

It's $799 and ships November 30, 2026. Want me to set up the checkout?
